custom_logic_notes: EA uses candlestick pattern recognition via external Candlestick.mqh class. PA_TYPE input selects between bullish (1) or bearish (2) trend patterns exclusively - they are mutually exclusive via if/else-if blocks. SL for longs is the lower of the two pattern candles' lows; SL for shorts is the higher of the two pattern candles' highs. No TP is set (value=0). Uses MQL4 compatibility functions (iTimeMQL4, ObjectCreateMQL4, etc.) for chart object creation. Pattern detection uses bars [1] and [2] (previous completed bars), not the current forming bar. No position management - can open unlimited positions on repeated signals.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement Candlestick.mqh candlestick class: OHLC extraction, body/wick/range calculation, bullish/bearish classification. MQL4 compatibility functions (iTimeMQL4, ObjectCreateMQL4, etc.) can be dropped for backtesting - they are chart annotation only. SL calculation uses min/max of two reference candle highs/lows - straightforward in Python. PA_TYPE acts as a mode switch between long-only and short-only strategies. No TP means positions stay open until SL hit or manual close - backtest must account for this. The CTrade.Buy/Sell calls use current Ask/Bid at bar open, so backtesting should use next-bar-open prices. No position count check means the EA can stack multiple positions on consecutive signals.
